cards.proof_strategy: Count ordered pairs of distinct elements, then quotient by their two possible orders.

Count ordered choices of two distinct elements as n·(n-1).

Use natural truncated division by two in the stated formula.
Apply the reviewed Nat.choose_two_right Lean theorem.

cards.canonical_statement: For a sample space Ω, a probability measure μ on Ω, and a real c, expectation(constant_rv(Ω,c), μ) = c.
cards.proof_strategy: Use normalization of a probability measure to evaluate the integral of a constant function.
sketch_steps: Fix the sample space, its probability measure, and a real constant c.
Recognize constant_rv(Ω,c) as the constant real random variable.
Derive integrability from constancy and the probability-measure normalization.
Evaluate the Bochner integral of the constant function.
Conclude that the expectation is c.
